title: Proxy request
description: What a sandboxed agent sends to a credential proxy. Carries no identity and no credential: the Warrant is resolved from the mTLS run identity (PRX-R-002).

provider.description: Which proxy surface this action belongs to.

action.description: The provider's own action name. Never an HTTP verb, never a CLI string. PRX-R-011.

target.description: Provider-scoped resource identifier the action applies to.

parameters.description: Action arguments. Secret handles are permitted only in fields the classifier entry marks resolvable (PRX-R-052).

idempotency_key.description: Agent-chosen. Scoped to the Warrant; replay returns the cached decision (PRX-R-013).

justification.description: The model's own reasoning for this call. Advisory: shown on the approval card and copied into an EscalationRequest. Never an input to the policy decision.

dry_run_hint.description: Agent's assertion that it expects this to be gated and wants only the provider dry-run. The proxy may ignore it; it never widens permission.

secretHandle.description: PRX-R-050. Resolved outbound only, never returned (PRX-R-051).
